ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This online course for students in the Rockford cohort begins on Thursday August 25th and ends on Thursday December 8th. This online course uses both Compass (course management system) for asynchronous and Elluminate for synchronous sessions. Students are highly recommended to have a reliable high-speed Internet connection and a microphone or headset with microphone are required for this course. Additional face-to-face sessions are scheduled on August 25th, October 6th and December 1st. Location of the face-to-face courses will be provided to the students at a later date.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $452.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
